name: Fix a node with no CNI config
objective: CKA › Services & Networking + Troubleshooting. Drill the whole pod-networking surface harder than the exam: how the CNI hands out pod IPs from the pod CIDR, the node-level CNI config, a no-hint diagnose-and-fix for a broken CNI, CoreDNS resolution, ClusterIP + endpoints, the full pod→Service datapath, headless Services, and NodePort. Graded exactly, per requirement.

questions.title: Diagnose & fix: a node with no CNI config
questions.teach:
When a node's CNI config under `/etc/cni/net.d/` is gone, the kubelet can't attach new pods there and they hang with no IP — and the kubelet says exactly that: `docker exec $W2 journalctl -u kubelet -e | grep -i cni` shows `cni config uninitialized` / `NetworkPluginNotReady`. The kindnet DaemonSet **rewrites that config every time its pod starts**, so bouncing kindnet on the bad node restores it.

**Gotcha:** target just the broken node with `--field-selector spec.nodeName=$W2` — don't delete the whole DaemonSet.
questions.prompt:
Pod `netbroken` (pinned to node `$W2`) is stuck with no IP — new pods on `$W2` aren't getting networking. Diagnose the fault on `$W2` and repair it so `netbroken` gets an IP. Don't delete `netbroken`; fix the node.

Target: `netbroken` has a `.status.podIP`.
questions.hint: Compare `$W2` to a healthy node: `docker exec $W2 ls /etc/cni/net.d` — the kindnet conflist is missing (and `docker exec $W2 journalctl -u kubelet -e | grep -i cni` shows `cni config uninitialized`). Make kindnet rewrite it by restarting its pod on that node: `kubectl -n kube-system delete pod -l app=kindnet --field-selector spec.nodeName=$W2`. Wait ~15s.
questions.solution:
docker exec $W2 ls /etc/cni/net.d   # empty: the CNI config is gone
docker exec $W2 journalctl -u kubelet -e | grep -i cni | tail   # 'cni config uninitialized'
kubectl -n kube-system delete pod -l app=kindnet --field-selector spec.nodeName=$W2
# the new kindnet pod rewrites /etc/cni/net.d/10-kindnet.conflist; netbroken then gets an IP
kubectl get pod netbroken -n cni-learn -o wide

verification.description: CNI restored on $W2 — netbroken now has an IP in the pod CIDR
